unfair_advantage: Exclusive access to Indium Phosphide (InP) technology, a crucial material for high-speed optical interconnects.
milestone_1: Commercialize InP-based optical interconnects for data centers and cloud computing infrastructure.
milestone_2: Secure key partnerships with major cloud service providers.
milestone_3: Expand product offerings to include high-speed optical interconnects for artificial intelligence (AI) applications.
kill_risk: Inability to secure key partnerships with major cloud service providers.
thesis_summary: AXTI has a unique advantage in the semiconductor industry due to its exclusive access to InP technology, but its high valuation and short cash runway pose significant risks.
thesis_breaks_if: AXTI fails to secure key partnerships with major cloud service providers within the next 2 years.
